justification: Critical: two production data loads (migration 091, 4 rear setbacks; migration 092, 67 building-area controls, both applied) that the buildable-area arithmetic serves, plus a changed DQ probe.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls: DQ-142 read 140 missing (council, housing type, control) combinations across 25 councils; DQ-139 read 15. 16 councils have DCP text stored in regulatory_provisions.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: DQ-139 counted rear setbacks only where front/side existed and read 11, hiding 140 gaps; deep soil was not counted as a footprint cap although it caps the footprint the same way.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Rows follow the existing dcp_setback_controls shape; chapter key, version and applicability are copied from each council's existing rows. Controls with no fixed figure use the existing 'NO FIGURE:' condition convention.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every quote is checked verbatim (whitespace-normalised) against its current regulatory_provisions row and every figure against its quote before SQL is written; Hornsby two-column pages were re-quoted from runs the extractor kept intact.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change; the arithmetic reads the same columns.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without these rows the buildable-area card shows no figure for these councils and types; a figure not in its quote would serve a wrong number, which the generator refuses.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dq142_build_controls_migration.py -q -o addopts= ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A figure not present as a whole number in its quote is accepted, or the 092 rows are removed (DQ-142 returns to 136).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: the first version of the figure check accepted 5 inside '5.5m'; test_digit_inside_a_larger_number_is_refused failed, the check was tightened, and all 67 applied figures still pass. Two Hornsby quotes were refused (two-column interleave) before any write and re-quoted. DQ-142 136 -> 69 after 092.

functions.name: value_in_quotes
functions.input: a figure, its unit and the verbatim quote fragments of one finding
functions.output: True only if the figure appears as a whole number in a quote (metres also as mm)
functions.if_none: Returns False and the finding is refused and named.

values.value: 67 DCP building-area controls (setbacks, site coverage, landscaped area, deep soil) for 15 councils
values.source: each council's DCP text stored in regulatory_provisions, quoted per row with section and PDF page
values.if_missing: The arithmetic withholds the footprint (DQ-139 three-state); no figure is invented.

queries.purpose: quote check against stored DCP text

queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND dev_type = %s AND control_type = %s AND is_current AND NOT needs_review AND (value present OR condition LIKE 'NO FIGURE:%')

break_it.scenario: A finding's figure is not in its own quote, or only inside a larger number (5 in 5.5m)
break_it.what_happens: The finding is refused and named; no SQL row is written for it

break_it.scenario: A quote was paraphrased or comes from a jumbled two-column page
break_it.what_happens: The finding is refused because the fragment is not in the stored provision text
break_it.how: normalised substring check against the named current provision

break_it.scenario: The generator is re-run after 092 was applied
break_it.what_happens: Every finding is refused as a duplicate of a decided row; nothing is double-inserted
break_it.how: duplicate guard on (lga, dev_type, control_type) with a decided row

break_it.scenario: A quote names a provision that is no longer current (the DCP was replaced)
break_it.what_happens: The finding is refused: the quote is only looked up in rows where is_current is true
break_it.how: WHERE id = %s AND is_current in the quote lookup

break_it.scenario: A control has no fixed figure (match the neighbours, a formula, a map)
break_it.what_happens: Stored with value NULL and condition 'NO FIGURE: ...' plus the DCP's own words; the arithmetic still withholds the footprint rather than using zero
break_it.how: generator refuses a NULL value without a 'NO FIGURE:' condition; DQ-139 keeps counting a pair with no numeric rear

post_merge.manual_verify: Migrations 091 and 092 are already applied (4 + 67 rows). python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142 reads 69; --id DQ-139 reads 13 (see tracker: two pairs gained a side figure while their DCP sets no numeric rear).

real_layer_exempt.migrations/091_rear_setbacks_quoted_from: Applied to production 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run (4 rows).
real_layer_exempt.migrations/092_dq142_building_area_contr: Applied to production 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run (67 rows; DQ-142 136 -> 69); every quote re-checked against its current provision.
